messages:
Alex: T-minus ~40 minutes for the midnight window. Final CR (PR #3421) merged, image tag rwd-v3.4.1. Quick sync — who is owning smoke and rollback? I left a small DB toggle behind a feature flag (migration:false).
Maria: I can take smoke ownership. Will run perf + e2e smoke. ETA to start once canary is at 1% and stable (15m). Link to checklist: https://confluence/release/smoke-checklist 
Devon: LGTM on the PR. Verified migration:false toggle is the default; we can flip to true if needed. Rollback plan: revert to image rwd-v3.4.0 and set feature flag back to migration:false.
Jen: QA here — I'll run the functional smoke steps and the critical prompts (embedding endpoint + chat regen). Will post results in thread. Are we keeping the slow-path quantized model in the mix for fallback?
Alex: Good — plan: canary at 1% for 15m, then 10% for 10m, then 100% if no regressions. Fallback lanes: region-b fallback to rwd-v3.4.0, and model-variant fallback to rwd-q8.
Maria: Running the smoke runner now (locally triggering canary preflight):
```bash
./deployctl preflight --image rwd-v3.4.1 --check e2e,latency,token-cost
```
Maria: preflight passed except a transient token-cost spike on long prompts (investigating). Will continue. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Devon: If token-cost persists after canary, we should hold and roll back. I can watch metrics and flip rollback if 5xxs or latency p95 > 1.2x baseline.
Alex: Agree. Quick approvals: please reply with ":thumbsup:" when you have ownership locked. Also confirm who will do the DB toggle if we need to flip migration:true.
Jen: :thumbsup: QA on deck. I can flip the DB toggle if Maria is on smoke and Devon is watching metrics.
Maria: :thumbsup: I'm on smoke and will post a short pass/fail with timestamps.
Devon: :thumbsup: I'll be watching dashboards and have the rollback command ready.
deploy-bot: Deploy job queued by Alex at 2026-03-17T00:40:00Z; canary policy: 1%->10%->100%; rollback alarm hooks attached.
Alex: OK locked. Checklist (quick):
- [x] PR merged (#3421)
- [x] Image pushed (rwd-v3.4.1)
- [x] Preflight smoke passed except noted spike
- [x] Smoke owner: Maria
- [x] QA owner: Jen
- [x] Metrics watch: Devon
- [ ] DB toggle owner (on-call for flip): Jen (will act)
If any of the owners drop, call out now. Otherwise proceeding with scheduled canary in ~30m. :rocket:
